title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Saltech Design Labs Pvt. Ltd., established in 2018, is a Startup India (DPIIT) and Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) recognized company working at the intersection of sustainability, circular economy, and advanced waste-to-infrastructure technologies.

Through its patented advanced recycling technology, Saltech converts single-use plastics, construction & demolition waste, and industrial by-products into high-performance, composite building materials such as paving blocks, tiles, bricks, sheets etc. Saltech also provides this technology to industries and government bodies for dry-waste recycling and new composite product development. This innovation is already pioneering Waste-to-Construction industry with the most recent project with Shri Somnath Trust in Gujarat, where plastic waste is being recycled into sustainable paving solutions for temple's precinct redevelopment, demonstrating how advanced recycling can support iconic national projects while conserving the environment. 

Saltech holds 10+ IPs (2 National & 1 International Granted Patents, 4 International Published Patents, 3 Trademarks) and 15+ Awards (National / International) for innovation in sustainable materials and recycling technologies. It has also been awarded by Hon. Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, for the ASHA India program by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India.

By joining our team, you become part of a mission to build local circular economies across India and globally to drive sustainable development and redefine how the world perceives waste.

**Details:**

**Type:**
Full-Time - On-Site, On-Floor, In-Office (Subject to project or work allocation)

**Location:**
Zak GIDC, Vahelal, Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

**Salary Range:**
 2,50,000 INR – 4,50,000 INR per annum (subject to experience and performance) 

**Work Hours:**
 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM

**Work Schedule:**
6 working days per week

**Responsibilities:**

* **Ideation, Conceptualization, Design & Development**
  of dry-waste recycling machines & sorting systems.
* **Design for manufacturing,**
  drafting and
  **efficient assembly of parts, components, and systems.**
* **Lead prototype fabrication,**
   run functional tests, 
  **measure performance, and iterate designs.**
* Define maintenance points, 
  **lubrication plans and critical spares list.**
* Produce Bill of Materials, assembly drawings, maintenance manuals for manufacturing and field teams.
* Coordinate with purchase team for timely procurement of components.
* **Conducting on-field market visits to verify job work.**
* Develop and implement QC to 
  **ensure the manufacturing team follows engineering drawings and GD&T standards.**
* Create and maintain complete engineering documentation including design drawings, installation manuals, and technical specifications.

**Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or related field.**
* Expertise in 
  **Design Engineering, Machine Design, Mechanical Engineering and Manufacturing.**
* Familiarity with
  **Product Design**
   and 
  **Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software**
   as well as Computer-Aided Manufacturing software
  **(SolidWorks, Creo, Mastercam, AutoCAD, CATIA, Key Shot, ANSYS etc.)**
* Experience in designing and developing prototypes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail.
* **Experience or interest in the waste management or sustainability industries is a plus.**
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Professional Fluency in English (Written/Spoken)

**Applicable for:**

* Candidate who can start immediately.
* Candidate who has relevant skills and interests.
* Candidate who can provide sample or demo of their previous/ current work experience.
* Candidates with proficiency in the local language or those residing in nearby states will be given preference.

**Selection Process:**

The selection process will comprise three stages:

* **HR Round**
* **Practical/Technical Assessment (Shop-floor Evaluation)**
* **Tool Test**
* **Final Managerial Round**

Depending on your performance during the interview, a training or probation period may be applicable to your candidacy.

The candidate will gain exposure to 
**advanced manufacturing operations, production optimization strategies, and quality management practices while working on industrial-scale mechanical systems.**

title: Team Member - Engineering
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Buildcast**
: Adani Buildcast is revolutionizing the construction ecosystem by bringing speed, precision, and sustainability to infrastructure development. Through advanced precast technologies, integrated design solutions, and stringent quality standards, we are redefining how India builds. Our goal is to deliver high-performance structures that combine engineering excellence with environmental responsibility—enhancing productivity, reducing timelines, and ensuring long-term durability. Adani Precast stands at the forefront of industrialized construction, shaping the future of modern infrastructure.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Design Engineer is responsible for designing structural design and analysis of precast building components using advanced engineering software, ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards. The role involves coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders to deliver accurate, efficient, and constructible designs while managing project schedules, resources, and risks through all design stages.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Structural Design & Analysis:**
Perform detailed structural analysis and design of precast components and building systems using engineering software such as Tekla, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, and CONSYS. Ensure stability, strength, and code compliance of all structural systems.
  
  
**Drawing Review & Verification**
Verify technical drawings prepared by junior engineers, detailers, and draftsmen for accuracy, constructability, and compliance with design intent. Provide feedback and necessary revi sions.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Collaborate with architects, contractors, clients, and various disciplines such as electrical and mechanical teams to integrate structural designs with other building systems. Coordinate with precast factory teams for production feasibility, and support vendors in understanding design requirements for embedded parts, joints, and reinforcement detailing.
  
  
**Risk Management**
Identify, assess, and mitigate design-related risks, ensuring the structural safety and viability of complex precast systems. Develop contingency solutions when required.
  
  
**Code Compliance & Standards**
Ensure all structural designs comply with relevant IS codes, local building standards, and project-specific requirements. Promote standardization of repetitive design elements for improved efficiency.
  
  
**Interdisciplinary Collaboration**
Facilitate regular coordination meetings with mechanical, electrical, and plumbing teams to resolve clashes and design conflicts in a proactive manner.
  
  
**Client & Contractor Engagement**
Engage with clients and contractors to present design approaches, address queries, and obtain approvals. Provide technical support during execution phases.
  
  
**Team Development**
Build a high-performing team. Set clear KPIs, track progress, and implement strategies for continuous improvement. Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success. Tracks and reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) for digital business success.
  
  
**Digital Mindset**
Champions a digital mindset within the organization to drive innovation and competitiveness. Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Other Lead Engineers
  
  
Junior Engineers
  
  
Draftsmen
  
  
Detailer
  
  
MEP Teams
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Precast Factory
  
  
Clients
  
  
Contractors
  
  
Vendors
  
  
Architects
  
  
Municipal/Statutory Bodies
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**
Bachelor's Engineering (Master's Engg is preferred)
  
  
**Work Experience**
8-15 years of experience in structural design, preferably in precast construction

title: Head – People & Culture
description:
**Company Description:**

DA GROUP INDIA, founded in 1938 by Hanuman Prasad Agarwal, has evolved from a cotton manufacturer into one of India’s most respected third-generation business groups. Over the past eight decades, the group has diversified into textiles, infrastructure, child care initiatives, and impactful CSR activities that support community development. DA GROUP INDIA operates in high-growth sectors of the Indian economy, offering team members exposure to dynamic and expanding business environments. The organization is committed to empowering youth and contributing to better livelihoods across the nation. Team members join a values-driven, growth-oriented group with a strong legacy and forward-looking vision.

**Role Description:**

The Head – People & Culture is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for shaping and driving the organization’s people strategy across DA GROUP INDIA. This role oversees end-to-end HR functions, including talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, and employee relations. The person in this role will design and implement people-centric policies, learning and development programs, and leadership-building initiatives that support business growth and employee engagement. Day-to-day responsibilities include partnering with business leaders on workforce planning, fostering an inclusive and high-performance culture, resolving people-related issues, and ensuring compliance with all relevant employment laws and regulations. The role also involves leading culture-building initiatives across diverse business units, supporting change management, and championing organizational values in every aspect of the employee experience.

* Candidates should possess leadership capabilities, including strategic thinking, stakeholder management, decision-making, and team development.
* Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across levels and diverse business units.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with Indian labor laws, HR compliance requirements, and best practices in diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Candidates should possess experience in designing and driving learning and development programs, succession planning, and leadership development frameworks.
* Relevant postgraduate or graduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in a senior HR or People & Culture leadership role, ideally within diversified or multi-business groups, will be highly beneficial.

title: US Tax Trainer & Mentor – Complex Tax
description:
Job Description :

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**US Tax Professional**
to join us as a
**US Tax Trainer & Mentor**
on a part-time contractual basis. The candidate will provide technical training, practical guidance, and ongoing mentoring to team members handling complex US individual and business tax returns.

The ideal candidate will possess in-depth knowledge of US federal and state taxation, extensive hands-on experience in complex tax return preparation and review, and the ability to simplify technical tax concepts through practical examples, case studies, and real-world scenarios.

This role will focus on strengthening the team's technical capabilities, improving tax return accuracy, resolving complex tax-related queries, and ensuring adherence to applicable tax laws, reporting requirements, and professional standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Training & Mentoring

* Conduct structured training sessions on US federal and state taxation.
* Train team members in the preparation and review of complex individual and business tax returns.
* Explain advanced tax concepts, calculations, deductions, credits, and reporting requirements.
* Conduct practical workshops using real-world scenarios and case studies.
* Mentor tax professionals to strengthen their technical knowledge and problem-solving capabilities.

2. Complex Tax Return Preparation & Review

* Provide technical guidance on complex US tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.
* Explain complex tax treatments, reporting positions, and compliance considerations.
* Review sample tax returns, supporting workpapers, and tax calculations.
* Identify errors, technical gaps, and areas for improvement, and recommend corrective actions.
* Guide team members in handling complex tax scenarios and exceptions.

3. Tax Research & Technical Support

* Resolve technical queries related to US federal and state taxation.
* Guide team members in conducting tax research and interpreting relevant tax regulations.
* Explain documentation standards, tax positions, and supporting evidence requirements.
* Provide guidance on complex tax issues and appropriate escalation procedures.
* Keep the team informed about relevant changes in US tax laws, regulations, and reporting requirements.

4. Training Material Development

* Develop structured training modules, practical assignments, and case studies.
* Prepare tax return review checklists, technical reference materials, and standard operating procedures.
* Create knowledge-sharing resources to support consistent tax preparation and review practices.
* Update training content to reflect relevant regulatory changes and recurring technical issues.

5. Performance Evaluation & Quality Improvement

* Assess team members' technical understanding through practical exercises and case discussions.
* Provide constructive feedback on tax return accuracy, technical judgment, and work quality.
* Identify knowledge gaps and recommend targeted training interventions.
* Support continuous improvement in tax preparation, review, documentation, and compliance processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* CPA, Enrolled Agent (EA), or an equivalent relevant US tax qualification preferred.
* A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline is advantageous.
* Strong working knowledge of US federal taxation and relevant state tax regulations.
* Practical experience with professional US tax preparation software and tax workpaper systems.

**Experience Required**

* Significant hands-on experience in US tax preparation and review.
* Strong expertise in complex individual and business tax returns.
* Experience handling Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.
* Prior experience training, mentoring, reviewing, or supervising tax professionals.
* Experience working with US CPA firms, public accounting firms, tax consulting practices, or international tax outsourcing organizations preferred.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* US Federal Taxation
* State Taxation
* Complex Individual Tax Returns
* Business Tax Returns
* Tax Return Preparation & Review
* Tax Research & Technical Interpretation
* Tax Compliance & Reporting
* Tax Calculations, Deductions & Credits
* Technical Training & Mentoring
* Quality Review & Error Identification
* Training Material Development
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
* Tax Preparation Software
* Communication & Knowledge Sharing

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a technically proficient US tax professional with strong practical experience and a passion for developing the capabilities of other tax professionals. They should be able to explain complex tax concepts clearly, provide actionable feedback, and guide team members through challenging tax scenarios.

title: Deputy Manager - FP&A
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic and analytical FP&A - Deputy Manager to do financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, MIS reporting, and business performance analysis. The ideal candidate will partner closely with business leaders to drive financial insights, support strategic decision-making, enhance reporting frameworks, and ensure robust financial governance across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

* Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning activities.
* Develop financial models and business scenarios to support strategic initiatives and decision-making.
* Analyze financial performance, business drivers, and key trends to provide actionable recommendations.

MIS Reporting & Business Analytics

Compliance & Governance

Qualification

Experience

* Strong expertise in Financial Modeling, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Variance Analysis.

* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Variance Analysis
* Financial Modeling
* Cash Flow Management
* Power BI & Data Analytics
* Business Partnering
* Strategic Thinking
* Process Automation
* Leadership & Team Management

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Qualification: CA / CMA

title: Medical Transcriber – Gujarati
description:
**About Us**

2une (pronounced ‘tune’) is a PhysicsWallah company building the data and human infrastructure for frontier AI.

We bring together high-quality real-world data, domain experts, and scalable human intelligence to help AI companies train, evaluate, and improve their models. From expert reasoning and human feedback to voice, medical, multimodal, and physical AI data, 2une enables frontier AI companies to access the people and data they need at scale.

**About the Role**

Healthcare AI is only as good as the data it learns from, and today very little of that data is in Gujarati. As a Medical Transcriber, you will help change that. You will listen to real medical conversations and dictations in Gujarati, often mixed with English, and turn them into accurate, structured transcripts that train speech-to-text systems for doctors and patients.

This is a chance to put your medical knowledge and your Gujarati fluency to work in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology, entirely from home. You will be trained by domain experts before you start, so you will know exactly what good work looks like from day one.

**What You Will Do**

* **Transcribe medical audio**

  – convert Gujarati and Gujarati–English conversations, consultations and dictations into accurate text, following clear project guidelines.
* **Get the medicine right**

  – capture medical terms, drug names, dosages, procedures and abbreviations correctly.
* **Label the audio**

  – tag speakers, background noise, unclear speech and other non-speech events.
* **Review and improve**

  – check and correct transcripts, including AI-generated ones, and help raise overall quality.
* **Deliver consistently**

  – meet quality and productivity targets and act on feedback from reviewers.

**Why You Will Enjoy This Role**

* **Work from anywhere**

  – fully remote, with no commute.
* **Use what you know**

  – your medical background and Gujarati fluency are exactly what this work needs.
* **Learn from experts**

  – structured training on medical transcription for AI before you begin.
* **Build a future-ready skill**

  – AI data work is a growing career path, and this experience counts.
* **Make a real impact**

  – help build healthcare technology that works for Gujarati speakers.
* **Grow with us**

  – strong performers will be considered for future projects and larger responsibilities.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fluent in Gujarati, including reading, writing and typing Gujarati script
* At least 1 year of experience as a medical transcriptionist,
  **or**

  has a pharmacy or paramedical background
* Good working knowledge of medical English and terminology
* Strong attention to detail and good time management
* Basic computer skills and comfort with web-based tools

**Good to Have**

* Experience in speech data annotation or medical scribing
* Familiarity with eScription, Fluency, Express Scribe or similar tools
* Medical transcription certification
* Exposure to regional Gujarati dialects (Kathiawadi, Surati, Kutchi)

**Work Setup**

* Monday to Saturday (10 AM -7 PM)
* Your own laptop, headphones and a stable internet connection
* Selection through a short training program and qualification test

title: Controls Senior Analyst / Specialist
description:
Job Description :

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Controls Senior Analyst / Specialist**
to support the design, documentation, assessment, and testing of financial processes and internal controls. The role will focus on Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR), Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs), financial process walkthroughs, control testing, and control gap assessments.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Internal Controls Manager to facilitate process walkthroughs, document risks and controls, evaluate control effectiveness, and coordinate control campaigns and reporting activities. The role will also contribute to developing AI-enabled risk and controls capabilities, including AI agents and automation for control testing and RACM creation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Financial Process Walkthroughs & Documentation

* Co-facilitate financial process walkthroughs with the Internal Controls Manager.
* Engage with relevant stakeholders to understand financial processes, identify risks, and document existing controls.
* Prepare process flowcharts, narratives, and supporting documentation.
* Identify key financial reporting risks and assess the adequacy of existing controls.
* Ensure process documentation is accurate, complete, and aligned with internal control requirements.

Risk & Control Matrices (RACMs)

* Prepare and maintain Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs) for relevant financial processes.
* Identify and document process risks, control objectives, control activities, control owners, and testing requirements.
* Assess the design and adequacy of controls in mitigating identified risks.
* Update RACMs based on process changes, control gaps, risk assessments, and stakeholder feedback.
* Maintain consistent documentation standards across controls and financial processes.

Controls Testing & Gap Assessments

* Perform controls testing to assess the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls.
* Gather and review supporting evidence to validate control performance.
* Identify control deficiencies, gaps, and potential weaknesses in financial processes.
* Document testing results, observations, and supporting analysis.
* Support the development and tracking of corrective actions to address identified control gaps.
* Escalate significant control deficiencies and testing issues to the Internal Controls Manager.

ICFR, UK Provision 29 & SOX

* Support Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) activities and related control frameworks.
* Assist with controls documentation and assessment aligned with applicable UK financial reporting governance requirements, including Provision 29 of the UK Corporate Governance Code, where applicable.
* Support Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control activities for relevant US reporting requirements, where applicable.
* Help maintain evidence, testing documentation, and reporting required for internal controls assessments.
* Monitor control compliance and support improvements in the overall control environment.

Controls Team Administration & Project Coordination

* Coordinate financial process walkthrough schedules, stakeholder meetings, and project plans.
* Maintain project trackers, control calendars, and documentation repositories.
* Monitor progress against agreed milestones and deliverables.
* Coordinate control campaigns and track completion status.
* Prepare status reports, identify delays, and escalate outstanding issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support effective communication across the controls team and business functions.

Risk Assessments & Management Reporting

* Perform controls risk assessments as required.
* Analyze identified risks and evaluate the effectiveness of existing mitigation measures.
* Prepare control status reports, gap analysis summaries, and management updates.
* Track remediation activities and follow up with control owners on outstanding actions.
* Provide clear documentation of findings, risks, and recommendations.

AI, Automation & Controls Innovation

* Support the development of AI-enabled risk and controls capabilities.
* Contribute to building AI agents to support controls documentation, risk analysis, and testing activities.
* Explore automation opportunities for RACM creation, evidence review, and controls testing.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to streamline manual control processes and improve efficiency.
* Assist in documenting, testing, and refining AI-enabled workflows for risk and internal controls activities.

**Qualifications**

* Qualified Accountant with ACCA or ACA qualification,
  **or**
  a relevant Risk Management / Internal Audit qualification such as CIA.
* Candidates with another relevant professional qualification in accounting, risk, or internal audit may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of financial processes, internal controls, and risk assessment methodologies.
* Knowledge of ICFR, UK Provision 29, or SOX frameworks will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in internal controls, financial process reviews, internal audit, risk assurance, or controls testing.
* Hands-on experience conducting financial process walkthroughs and documenting process flows.
* Practical experience preparing and maintaining Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs).
* Experience performing controls testing, assessing control effectiveness, and documenting control gaps.
* Experience conducting risk assessments and supporting remediation activities.
* Prior experience in Real Estate, Construction, or Property Development is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience with GRC, Internal Audit, or Risk Management tools will be an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of financial processes and internal control frameworks.
* Practical experience in RACM preparation, controls testing, and control gap assessments.
* Ability to document financial processes, risks, controls, and testing outcomes accurately.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to assess control design and operating effectiveness.
* Good project coordination and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation quality.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and control activities.
* Interest in AI-enabled controls, process automation, and risk technology.

**Technical Skills**

**Communication Skills**

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to conduct process walkthroughs and communicate effectively with control owners and stakeholders.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to explain control gaps, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Confidence in coordinating meetings, tracking actions, and escalating issues professionally.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Hands-on experience with financial process walkthroughs, RACMs, controls testing, and control gap assessments.
* Strong Microsoft Visio skills and the ability to develop clear, accurate process flowcharts.

* Organized, analytical, and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and project deadlines.

description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an AML Analyst to support M-Pesa financial crime risk management by identifying, investigating, and monitoring suspicious transactions. The role focuses on ensuring timely escalation of potential risks, maintaining high-quality investigation records, and supporting compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and internal policies. This opportunity is based in Ahmedabad and involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders including the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Assess daily AML alerts and ensure timely closure or escalation of outstanding cases
* Escalate confirmed suspicious activities promptly to the AML Supervisor and MLRO
* Conduct sanctions and Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screening and customer profile reviews
* Review transaction monitoring alerts in line with established procedures and investigation standards
* Evaluate transaction patterns, including geographic relevance of remitters and beneficiaries
* Maintain accurate, clear, and auditable records of all investigations and decisions
* Support preparation of monthly AML reports and management information dashboards
* Provide insights to stakeholders on emerging risks and transaction monitoring trends
* Ensure compliance with personal data protection standards and internal governance processes
* Work effectively with systems and tools supporting AML monitoring and investigations

**Who You Are**

* Experience of 2–3 years within a financial services or AML-focused environment (AML exposure preferred)
* Understanding of AML frameworks, controls, and industry best practices
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail, with a structured approach to investigations
* Ability to manage workload independently with a focus on quality and timeliness
* Proficiency in MS Office tools for reporting and analysisEffective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly
* Demonstrates accountability, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement mindset
* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Law, Finance, Management, or a related discipline

**Not a perfect fit?**
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Exposure to global financial crime compliance practices within a leading telecommunications organisation
* Opportunity to work on M-Pesa, a widely recognised digital financial services platform
* A collaborative and supportive environment that encourages continuous learning
* Development of specialised AML investigation and risk assessment expertise
* Experience working with cross-functional and international stakeholders

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced transaction monitoring and AML investigation techniques
* Sanctions screening and PEP risk assessment methodologies
* Risk identification, escalation protocols, and regulatory reporting practices
* Data analysis and interpretation for financial crime trends
* Stakeholder communication and compliance reporting skills

**VOIS Equal Opportunaity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

As the Senior VoIP Support Engineer, you’ll own the stability and quality of the company’s customers’ real-time communication platforms.
**You’ll be the escalation point (L2/L3) for complex SIP, media and platform issues,**
working with customers, NOC and engineering teams to diagnose problems quickly, restore service and prevent repeat incidents.

**Must Have Skills and Experience
*(These are minimum requirements, not nice to haves)***

* **4-7 years in VoIP/telecom**
  support or operations.
* Strong understanding of
  **SIP, SDP, RTP/RTCP**
  , and related protocols and call flows.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of
  **Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, or Asterisk.**
* Proficiency with packet analysis tools
  **(Wireshark, sngrep, tcpdump).**
* Solid
  **Linux**
  administration skills (CentOS/Debian/Ubuntu), including shell, logs, networking, and services.
* Understanding of
  **NAT, firewalls, TCP/UDP, DNS, and VPN/IPsec in VoIP**
  environments.
* Working knowledge of
  **MySQL/PostgreSQL**
  and basic querying for CDR analysis.
* Experience with monitoring and ticketing tools
  **(Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, Jira, or Zendesk)**
  .
* Strong English, both written and verbal communication, with the ability to handle customer escalations calmly.

**Key Responsibilities**

  including call failures, one-way audio, registration problems, poor call quality, and routing issues.

* Available to attend periodic maintenance windows during off-peak hours.

title: Associate Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Network & Cloud Cybersecurity Specialist is responsible for securing cloud and network environments, mitigating cyber threats, and ensuring compliance with security frameworks. This role focuses on threat detection, incident response, and implementing best practices to protect enterprise infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Network & Cloud CyberSecurity Specialist**
**Network Security Tools And Technologies Management**
Configuration and management of network security tools (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, network monitoring platforms, proxy, NAC etc).
  
  
Ensure network security technologies are properly tuned, updated, and optimized to detect and prevent security incidents.
  
  
**Network Security Operations Management**
Manage the day-to-day operations of the network security team, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response to network security incidents.
  
  
Ensure that network security controls (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, network monitoring tools) are deployed and optimized to protect the organization’s infrastructure.
  
  
Establish and lead a proactive approach to identifying and addressing emerging network threats, vulnerabilities, and attack patterns.
  
  
**Incident Response And Risk Management**
Assist organization’s network incident response plan, ensuring rapid identification, containment, and mitigation of security incidents and breaches.
  
  
Lead root cause analysis of network security incidents, ensuring lessons learned are applied to enhance security measures.
  
  
Conduct risk assessments of network systems and lead efforts to implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies and controls.
  
  
**Cloud Security & Zero Trust**
Implement and oversee cloud security controls and cloud firewalls.
  
  
Support Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) strategies, ensuring robust authentication, authorization, and micro-segmentation.
  
  
Manage privileged access controls and enforce security policies to mitigate insider threats and external risks.
  
  
**Collaboration With Cross-Functional Teams**
Partner with other departments, such as IT, compliance, legal, and risk management, to ensure alignment of network security strategies with broader organizational objectives.
  
  
Work closely with senior executives to provide updates on network security risks and vulnerabilities, offering recommendations for improvement.
  
  
Collaborate with other cybersecurity leaders to develop a cohesive, integrated approach to security across the enterprise.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement And Innovation**
Stay informed on the latest network security trends, technologies, and emerging threats to ensure the organization is protected from evolving risks.
  
  
Drive the evaluation and implementation of new network security technologies and tools to enhance the organization’s cybersecurity capabilities.
  
  
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the network security operations team by encouraging innovation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance**
Ensure that network security operations adhere to relevant compliance requirements, ISO 27001
  
  
Oversee internal and external audits related to network security, ensuring all necessary documentation and evidence are provided.
  
  
Maintain a strong understanding of global regulatory trends and ensure that network security practices meet the highest industry standards.
  
  
**Network Security Reporting And Documentation**
Prepare and deliver regular reports to executive leadership on the health of the network security program, including threat intelligence, incident status, risk assessments, and compliance status.
  
  
Ensure that network security processes and configurations are documented clearly and kept up to date.
  
  
Maintain and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the effectiveness of network security initiatives.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Department Heads
  
  
Internal Auditors
  
  
Risk Management Team
  
  
Cybersecurity & IT Infrastructure Team
  
  
Cloud & Network Engineering Team
  
  
Risk & Compliance Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Cloud Service Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  
  
Security Auditors & Consultants
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
External Security Consultants
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Certifications :
  
  
CEH, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, Cisco CCNP Security, Checkpoint, paloalto certificates.
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
5+ years in network security, cloud security, and cybersecurity operations.

description:

Saundh’s collections are designed for the modern, globally minded individual who values both cultural roots and modern style. The company focuses on creating thoughtfully crafted pieces that subtly blend traditional beauty with modern sensibilities, offering a distinctive and refined fashion experience.

**Role Description**
The Ecommerce Specialist at Saundh will manage day-to-day operations of the brand’s online sales channels, including product listing, inventory updates, and pricing accuracy. This full-time, on-site role in Ahmedabad involves monitoring website performance, analyzing sales data, and optimizing product presentation to improve conversion and customer experience. The specialist will coordinate with design, marketing, and operations teams to plan campaigns, update collections, and ensure timely order processing and dispatch. Responsibilities also include handling customer queries related to online orders, tracking, and returns, and supporting the implementation of promotional strategies across digital platforms.

1. Website & E-commerce Operations

· Manage daily website operations and ensure smooth website functioning.

· Upload and maintain product listings, descriptions, images, pricing, sizes, inventory, and product attributes.

· Ensure product pages are accurate, visually consistent, and aligned with Saundh’s brand standards.

· Coordinate website updates, new collection launches, and campaign requirements.

· Conduct regular website audits to identify broken links, missing images, incorrect information, and inventory discrepancies.

· Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve website issues promptly.

2. E-commerce Performance & Optimisation

· Monitor key website metrics, including traffic, conversion rate, average order value, revenue, and cart abandonment.

· Prepare weekly and monthly e-commerce performance reports.

· Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and conversions.

· Review website navigation, search, filters, landing pages, product discovery, and checkout experience.

· Support website optimisation initiatives to improve customer experience and online performance.

· Track the impact of changes made to website content, merchandising, and customer journeys.

3. Competitor Analysis & Benchmarking

· Conduct regular competitor analysis across relevant fashion and lifestyle brands.

· Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, product presentation, collection launches, and website experience.

· Benchmark Saundh’s website against competitors to identify gaps and opportunities.

· Prepare concise competitor analysis reports with actionable recommendations.

· Track relevant e-commerce trends and best practices suited to Saundh’s premium brand positioning.

4. Product Merchandising & Campaign Execution

· Manage product placement, collection visibility, sorting, and online merchandising.

· Coordinate homepage banners, landing pages, promotional content, and new collection launches.

· Ensure campaign pages and product assortments are updated accurately and on time.

· Support online sales campaigns and seasonal promotional activities.

· Monitor product availability and ensure sold-out products and inventory updates are reflected accurately.

· Work with the marketing and creative teams to ensure timely execution of website requirements.

6. Customer Experience & Order Management

· Monitor order processing, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, and fulfilment timelines.

· Coordinate with customer service and logistics teams to resolve order-related issues.

· Track customer complaints and recurring website or fulfilment issues.

· Support initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, reduce returns, and increase repeat purchases.

5. Cross-functional Coordination

· Coordinate with marketing, creative, inventory, warehouse, and customer service teams on e-commerce requirements.

· Ensure timely execution of website updates, campaign changes, and product launches.

* · Share regular progress updates and flag operational issues or delay

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The OT Cybersecurity Executive will be responsible for supporting and implementing cybersecurity measures to safeguard the organization's Operational Technology (OT) environments. This includes ensuring the security of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT assets that manage critical infrastructure. The role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, implementing best practices, and ensuring the security of OT systems against evolving cyber threats.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OT Cybersecurity Executive**
**Operational Technology (OT) Security**
Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.
  
  
Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.
  
  
Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.
  
  
**Incident Response And Management**
Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.
  
  
Investigate and perform root-cause analysis for OT-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.
  
  
Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.
  
  
**Collaboration With IT And OT Teams**
Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross-domain security breaches.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.
  
  
Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.
  
  
**Vulnerability Management**
Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.
  
  
**Security Monitoring And Threat Intelligence**
Continuously monitor OT systems and networks for any unusual activities, security breaches, or threats using appropriate tools and techniques.
  
  
Leverage threat intelligence platforms to stay informed about the latest cyber threats targeting OT environments and recommend proactive defense measures.
  
  
Perform regular updates to OT security monitoring systems and tools to detect emerging threats.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
OT Cybersecurity Manager / Head of Cybersecurity
  
  
IT and Network Operations Teams
  
  
Engineering & Development Teams
  
  
Human Resources (HR)
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
OT equipment and software vendors
  
  
Third-party cybersecurity service providers
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Relevant certifications such Global Industrial Cyber Security Practical experience with securing industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT assets and with OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, NERC CIP).
  
  
Knowledge of OT network protocols and systems, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and others commonly used in industrial environments and with security tools and technologies used in OT environments (e.g., intrusion detection systems, firewalls, SIEM).
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
3+ years of overall experience , with at least 1 year focused on OT or industrial control systems security.

title: Care Companion
description:
**Company Description**
Sathiyaa is a companion care organization based in Ahmedabad, dedicated to ensuring that aging never leads to loneliness. The team provides compassionate, relationship-focused support through regular visits, conversation, and presence for older adults who need social and emotional connection. Services include senior companion care, emotional and social support, assistance with daily routines and activities, and personalized care plans tailored to each individual’s needs and interests. Sathiyaa also works closely with families, offering regular updates to provide reassurance and peace of mind. Guided by the vision “Aging with Dignity, Living with Passion,” Sathiyaa aims to help every senior feel valued, connected, and fully alive at every stage of life.

**Role Description**
The Care Companion is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Ahmedabad Area, focused on providing seniors with warm, reliable companionship and everyday support. Day-to-day responsibilities include visiting assigned seniors, engaging in meaningful conversation, participating in light activities, and encouraging social interaction to reduce isolation and loneliness. The Care Companion helps with basic daily routines and non-medical tasks such as reminders, organization, and support with staying active, while respecting each senior’s independence and dignity. The role also involves observing changes in behavior or mood, sharing timely updates with families and supervisors, and following personalized care plans. The Care Companion works closely with the Sathiyaa team to maintain a safe, supportive environment and to build trusting, long-term relationships with seniors and their families.

**Qualifications**

* Strong interpersonal skills and communication abilities to build trust, engage in conversation, and provide emotional support to seniors.
* Customer service mindset, with patience, empathy, and a commitment to delivering respectful, person-centered care.
* Basic understanding of medicine or senior health needs; exposure to critical care medicine or healthcare settings is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Ability to observe and report changes in a senior’s routine, mood, or wellbeing clearly and responsibly.
* Prior experience in elder care, social work, counseling, or community service is highly beneficial.
* Fluency in local languages and English, with the ability to communicate clearly with seniors and families.
* Reliable, punctual, and comfortable working on-site across the Greater Ahmedabad Area; ability to travel locally as needed.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma; additional training in caregiving, psychology, or healthcare is a plus.

title: Senior Auditor
company: Hiral Prajapati & Co LLP Chartered Accountants
description:
**Company Description**
Hiral Prajapati & Co LLP Chartered Accountants is a professionally managed firm established in 2014 and converted into an LLP (LLP Identification No. ACG-1327) to deliver comprehensive professional services. The firm provides Auditing & Assurance, direct and indirect tax consultancy, outsourcing services, accounting, manpower management, secretarial services, legal representations, and management consultancy. Its multidisciplinary team includes Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, Advocates, Corporate Financial Advisors, and Tax Consultants who offer sound financial advice and proactive, personalized support. Regular interaction with industry and professionals enables the firm to stay current with regulatory and business developments and to help clients manage risk and pursue growth opportunities. The firm’s focus on specialized skills and industry experience supports a culture of excellence in client service.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Auditor will be responsible for planning, executing, and reviewing statutory, tax, and internal audits for clients across diverse industries. Day-to-day activities include assessing internal controls, testing compliance with regulatory and tax requirements, analyzing financial statements, identifying risks, and documenting audit findings with clear working papers and reports. The role involves coordinating with clients to obtain necessary information, discussing audit observations, and recommending practical improvements in processes, risk management, and financial reporting. The Senior Auditor will guide and supervise team members, ensure adherence to professional standards, and support partners in finalizing audit deliverables and presentations. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Bharuch district.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong auditing and assurance skills, including financial statement analysis, internal control evaluation, and preparation of detailed audit documentation.
* Knowledge of direct and indirect tax laws, compliance requirements, and ability to work with tax-related audit and consultancy assignments.
* Proficiency in accounting principles, Indian GAAP/Ind AS, and practical experience with accounting systems and basic tax and finance software.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements, supervise junior team members, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality and professional standards.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for client interaction, report writing, and presentation of audit findings and recommendations.
* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification preferred; candidates pursuing final CA or with equivalent professional certifications may be considered.
* Experience in a Chartered Accountancy firm or similar professional services environment, particularly in statutory, tax, or internal audits, is highly beneficial.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and willingness to continuously update knowledge of accounting, tax, and regulatory developments.

title: Zoho Systems Lead
description:
**About Pravegh**

Pravegh is a full-service offshore operations management and product development company headquartered in Ahmedabad. We run core business operations for companies across the globe: customer experience, technical support, revenue operations, finance and accounting, and sales operations. Alongside operations, we design and build digital products.

Our operations run on Zoho One, and we are hiring the person who will own it.

**The role**

As Zoho Systems Lead, you will own Pravegh's Zoho systems end-to-end: how they are designed, built, connected, secured and used. You will decide what gets built and how, be the in-house authority on Zoho, and bring in outside partners when the work needs them. You will report to the COO and work closely with the Operations Manager and the team leads.

This is a leadership role for someone who has designed and built Zoho systems, not only administered them.

**Key responsibilities**

**Systems ownership**

* Own Pravegh's Zoho One estate, including CRM, Books, Desk, Analytics and Creator, and the way the apps work together.
* Set the design standards every build follows, and decide what is built where.
* Keep a current system map and change log, so anyone can see what exists and what changed.
* Manage licences, editions and outside Zoho partners against agreed scope.

**Process design and automation**

* Turn how the sales, finance, support and operations teams work into clear, connected processes in Zoho.
* Automate them with workflows, blueprints, Deluge functions and custom modules where standard settings fall short.
* Connect Zoho to other business tools through APIs and webhooks.
* Build and test every change in a sandbox before it reaches live users.

**Data, reporting and security**

* Set data standards so records are complete, consistent and free of duplicates.
* Build dashboards and reports in Zoho Analytics that leadership can rely on without manual work.
* Own access control and data security in Zoho, aligned to standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

**People and delivery**

* Train each team on the systems they use, and write the SOPs and guides they work from.
* Give the team a fast way to raise system problems, and see each one through to a fix.
* Plan builds with clear owners, deadlines and test cases, and report progress every week.

**What success looks like in your first year**

* Every team works in one connected Zoho system, without side spreadsheets.
* Core processes run from start to finish in the system, with nothing re-keyed between apps.
* Leadership gets the reports it needs straight from the system.
* Every change is tested before release and recorded in the change log.
* The system is documented well enough that any part of it can pass to a trained backup.

**What you bring**

* 5 or more years of hands-on Zoho work, including at least 2 years leading implementations end to end.
* Deep working knowledge of Zoho CRM, Books and Desk, and how they connect.
* Strong Deluge, and hands-on experience with APIs and webhooks.
* Reporting experience in Zoho Analytics or SQL.
* Experience building systems for US businesses.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain system decisions to people who are not technical.
* The habit of documenting what you build and training users yourself.

**Good to have**

* Zoho certifications.
* Hands-on experience building in Zoho Creator.
* Working knowledge of accounting and inventory processes.
* JavaScript or Python.

**What we offer**

* Full ownership of the Zoho systems our operations run on, with the scope to design them.
* Direct work with the founders, and decisions made in days, not quarters.
* Room to grow as the operation scales.
* Fair and competitive compensation.

**Working hours and location**

Ahmedabad, on-site/hybrid, full-time. Evening shift, 6:30 pm to 3:30 am IST, working US business hours with the operations team.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note on a Zoho system you designed and built end-to-end: what problem it solved, and what changed after. Email: dishant@pravegh.com.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager – Production

Specialization: Automotive Manufacturing | Rubber Moulding | Shop-Floor Operations

Company: Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Chhatral, Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Experience: 3–7 Years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a relevant discipline

Industry Preference: Automobile / Automotive Components Manufacturing

About Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing and engineering company specializing in precision-engineered components and manufacturing solutions. With a focus on quality, productivity, automation, and continuous improvement, we serve demanding industrial and OEM customers through reliable manufacturing capabilities and process-driven operations.

Visit us: https://www.schilthornprecision.com/

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer – Production with experience in the automobile or automotive components industry, particularly in rubber moulding and related manufacturing processes.

The ideal candidate should have strong shop-floor exposure, a practical understanding of production processes, and the ability to manage manpower, machines, productivity, quality, and delivery commitments. The candidate must be capable of identifying production bottlenecks, resolving process-related issues, reducing rejection and downtime, and driving continuous improvement.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can take ownership of daily production performance and deliver measurable improvements in manufacturing efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Planning & Shop-Floor Execution

Execute daily and monthly production plans in line with customer requirements and dispatch schedules.

Monitor production output against targets, identify bottlenecks, and take corrective action to achieve planned productivity.

Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machines, tools, moulds, raw materials, and other production resources.

Coordinate with Planning, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth production flow.

Monitor shift-wise production, work-in-progress, downtime, rejection, and pending orders.

2. Rubber Moulding & Manufacturing Process Control

Manage and monitor rubber moulding operations, where applicable, including process parameters, mould condition, cycle time, and output.

Understand critical moulding parameters such as temperature, pressure, curing time, material preparation, and demoulding.

Identify and troubleshoot process defects such as flash, short moulding, air traps, dimensional variation, and other moulding-related rejections.

Ensure correct machine setup, mould changeover, process settings, and first-piece approval before starting production.

Maintain process consistency and work with Quality and Maintenance teams to minimize mould-related issues and unplanned downtime.

Support process validation, trial runs, new product introduction, and process stabilization.

3. Exposure to Other Manufacturing Processes

Coordinate and control production activities involving relevant processes such as CNC machining, turning, drilling, cutting, fabrication, assembly, or other component-manufacturing operations, depending on product requirements.

Understand process flow, machine capability, tooling requirements, cycle time, and quality checkpoints.

Ensure standard operating procedures and approved process parameters are followed.

Identify opportunities to simplify operations, improve machine utilization, and reduce material wastage.

4. Quality & Rejection Control

Ensure production conforms to approved drawings, specifications, control plans, and customer quality requirements.

Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and process deviations; initiate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Apply problem-solving tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and 8D, in coordination with the Quality team.

Ensure adherence to in-process inspection, first-piece approval, traceability, and process documentation requirements.

Support customer complaint resolution and corrective/preventive action implementation.

5. Productivity & Continuous Improvement

Track and improve key production KPIs, including output, cycle time, rejection percentage, machine downtime, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Drive initiatives to reduce cycle time, improve yield, minimize changeover time, and eliminate production losses.

Implement 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and other practical shop-floor improvement initiatives.

Analyze recurring production problems and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Support cost reduction through improved process efficiency, manpower utilization, and material consumption.

6. Manpower & Team Management

Allocate operators and workers according to production plans, machine requirements, and skill levels.

Monitor operator performance, attendance, discipline, and adherence to standard work practices.

Train operators on machine operation, process parameters, quality requirements, and safe working practices.

Ensure shift handovers are effective and production issues are communicated clearly.

Build a culture of accountability, productivity, quality ownership, and teamwork.

7. Maintenance, Safety & Documentation

Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive maintenance, breakdown resolution, and reduction of machine downtime.

Ensure proper handling and maintenance of machines, moulds, tools, fixtures, and production equipment.

Enforce shop-floor safety, PPE compliance, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.

Maintain production reports, shift reports, rejection records, downtime logs, and process documentation.

Ensure compliance with applicable work instructions and the company's quality management system.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on measurable shop-floor performance, including:

Achievement of daily and monthly production targets.

Reduction in rejection, rework, and material wastage.

Improvement in machine utilization and production efficiency.

Reduction in machine breakdowns and unplanned downtime.

Adherence to customer delivery schedules.

Improvement in cycle time and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Compliance with quality, safety, 5S, and production documentation requirements.

Required Skills & Competencies

Practical knowledge of automotive manufacturing and shop-floor production management.

Hands-on exposure to rubber moulding and mould-related production activities is strongly preferred.

Understanding of manufacturing process parameters, cycle time, tooling, and machine utilization.

Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.

Ability to manage production teams and coordinate across departments.

Knowledge of production planning, rejection control, and continuous improvement techniques.

Working knowledge of Excel and ERP/MRP systems.

Strong ownership, discipline, communication, and execution skills.

Qualification & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

3–7 years of relevant experience in production, preferably in automotive or automotive component manufacturing.

Candidates with direct experience in rubber moulding, polymer/rubber components, or similar process-driven manufacturing environments will be preferred.

Experience in managing shop-floor manpower, production targets, quality issues, and process improvements is essential.

Familiarity with IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive, technically sound, and execution-oriented production professional who is comfortable working on the shop floor and taking ownership of production performance.

The candidate should be able to independently handle day-to-day production challenges, troubleshoot process issues, lead operators, improve productivity, and ensure consistent quality and on-time delivery.

Preference will be given to candidates currently working with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, or Tier-2 automotive component manufacturers who have hands-on production experience rather than purely planning or documentation-based experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV mentioning current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and relevant manufacturing-process experience.
