title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.
* Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.
* Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.
* Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.
* Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.

Who you are

* **Mandatory: real, hands-on ground experience.**
   8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have stood on sites, managed crews and contractors, and know how a PNG connection is built, from survey to gas-on. Desk-only or consulting backgrounds will not be considered.
* **Deep relationships across PSUs, government and utilities.**
   You have strong, active links with decision-makers in gas, power and other utility companies, PSUs and the government departments that oversee them, and you know how they evaluate, approve and buy.
* **Commercial instinct.**
   You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. You can open a door, run a meeting and follow through to a decision.
* **Equally at home on a site and in a boardroom.**
   You can win over a plumbing supervisor, and you can present calmly and crisply to an MD.
* **Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi,**
   with clear spoken and written English for leadership meetings and proposals.
* **A natural trainer and explainer.**
   You can take a non-technical crew through a new app and get them using it the same day.
* **A sharp observer.**
   You notice how work really gets done, and you can describe it clearly enough for a product team to act on.
* **Firm and fair with contractors.**
   You hold people to commitments without breaking the relationship.
* **Comfortable with data.**
   You live in dashboards and Excel, and you act on what the numbers show.
* **A builder.**
   You want to create something new, are comfortable with ambiguity, and own outcomes rather than tasks.
* **Graduate engineer**
   (mechanical, civil, chemical or petroleum preferred), or equivalent field experience.

Good to have

* Experience at a Gujarat city gas company, or with contractors who work for one.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement: tenders, empanelment and approval processes.
* Exposure to SAP in a utility (service orders, contractor billing or customer service).
* Experience rolling out a field app or digital process to a distributed, non-office workforce.
* Experience in a startup, or in a new-business role inside a larger company.
* A network of contractors, plumbers and site supervisors in Gujarat.

Location, pay and how to apply

* **Base:**
   Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
* **Travel:**
   frequent day trips to pilot sites and service centres in Gujarat (for example Surat and Bharuch), plus travel to other states for client meetings.
* **Ownership:**
   [ESOPs or equity, to be discussed].
* **Growth:**
   as the product scales, you build and lead the field and client team across utilities.

**To apply,**
 send your CV to Vivek.slaria@originbluy.com with a short note on one field rollout you led and one client you helped win: what was stuck, what you did, and what changed.

**268,000 students across 70+ countries**

**₹51,444 crore**

**20% market share**

**Job Description**

**Key roles and responsibilities**

**Implementation of risk management tools, Initiate processes Improvement and Impart training**

* Adherence to credit decisioning parameters as per Credit Policy on loan proposals
* Initiate new product and policy amendments based on local market experience.
* Initiate and Implement process improvements for better customer experience while maintaining the organization’s risk appetite.
* Deliver structured training regularly to both internal teams and business associates.

**Relationship Management, Customer Service and Team Management**

* Manage end to end credit approval process within agreed turnaround times (TATs) and be responsible for all underwriting decisions, approvals, deviations and exceptions for the location
* Collaborate with recoveries and analytics teams to generate business insights to improve the credit appraisal process
* Identify and mitigate risk through regular portfolio monitoring and take timely decisions on exposure levels, collateral etc.
* Effectively manage the location credit team and guide team members to take credit risk decisions aligned with the company’s risk appetite
* Ensure the provision of ongoing training and that all employees are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles

**Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with all relevant credit policies and procedures

Identify, analyze and propose mitigation measures for various risks applicable to the credit function at the location

**Skills**

* Extensive Knowledge of retail loans preferably Education Loans, LAP or PL products
* Hands-on experience of Credit Underwriting, Credit verification processes, People management skills.
* Excellent communications abilities in English and any regional language
* Servicing ability in terms of processing TAT (Turnaround Time) and relationship management.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, Team player and Motivator

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Account, Chartered Financial Analyst or MBA Finance

**Experience**

* 12-15 years of related work experience in the financial services sector

title: Senior SFMC
description:
**Company Description**
Mavlers is an enterprise lifecycle marketing partner that helps brands unlock more value from their CRM and marketing automation investments. The company blends strategy, platform expertise, campaign execution, and managed services to support personalized customer experiences at scale. A team of 400+ specialists works across leading platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, HubSpot, Marketo Engage, Pardot, Adobe Campaign, Klaviyo, Iterable, and Customer.io. Mavlers provides end-to-end support, including CRM strategy, lifecycle marketing, journey design, platform implementation, integrations, campaign production, QA, personalization, reporting, and ongoing managed services. Trusted by 100+ brands and backed by over 15 years of global delivery experience, Mavlers operates as an extension of enterprise marketing teams to accelerate campaigns while maintaining governance and quality.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) role is a full-time remote position responsible for leading the design, build, and optimization of multi-channel marketing programs within SFMC. Day-to-day tasks include configuring and maintaining SFMC modules (such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio), developing data extensions and segmentation strategies, and implementing complex customer journeys and trigger-based campaigns. The role involves translating business requirements into scalable SFMC solutions, collaborating with marketing, CRM, and analytics teams, and ensuring campaigns adhere to data privacy, compliance, and brand guidelines. The Senior SFMC professional will also troubleshoot platform issues, perform QA and testing, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement through A/B testing, reporting, and best-practice recommendations. Mentoring junior team members and contributing to platform standards and documentation are also part of this role.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Salesforce Marketing Cloud expertise, including hands-on experience with Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, and data extensions.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Company:**
UltraCare PRO (Zealmax Innovations Pvt. Ltd.)

**Experience:**
5-7 years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Why this role exists-**

UltraCare PRO already sells across marketplaces, quick commerce and our own website. The next step is to become a brand people look for by name and recommend to others.

Your mandate is to grow the brand organically, in both brand equity and revenue. We want growth that lasts: demand that compounds through search, content, community and word of mouth, not revenue that only grows when ad spend does.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the direction for four teams and stay close enough to the work to write a brief yourself, give sharp feedback on a design, or work out why a page lost its ranking.

**What you'll own**

**Brand strategy**

•        Build and run a 12-month brand and organic growth plan, with targets for brand demand and organic revenue.

•        Define what UltraCare PRO stands for and how it looks and sounds, in a brand system every team works from.

•        Set a clear architecture for the master brand and its sub-brands, so each has a job and the core brand gets stronger.

•        Keep the brand consistent wherever customers meet it: website, marketplace listings, quick commerce, packaging, social and ads.

**SEO**

•        Own SEO for our website end to end, from technical health to content and backlinks, and judge it on revenue, not just traffic.

•        Grow branded search on Google and the marketplaces, and track our share of search against competitors.

**Content**

•        Build an education-led content engine. Many people still don't know what a TENS machine does or which device is right for them, so clear explainers do a lot of the selling.

•        Turn reviews, customer stories and expert voices such as physiotherapists into content people trust.

**Social media**

•        Own organic social: strategy, calendar, formats and community management.

•        Run creator partnerships that build credibility and drive sales, and measure them properly.

**Design**

•        Lead the design team and raise the bar on quality and turnaround.

•        Keep performance marketing, marketplace and quick commerce teams supplied with on-brand creative, and feed back what's working.

**Team and collaboration**

•        Hire, coach and grow your teams, with clear goals and regular reviews.

•        Work closely with performance marketing, ecommerce, quick commerce and D2C so brand and performance pull in the same direction.

•        Brief and manage agencies and freelancers where they add speed or skill.

**Measurement**

•        Report monthly on branded search, share of search, organic traffic and revenue, social engagement, and ratings and reviews.

•        Show how organic growth improves blended MER over time, so each rupee we spend brings back more revenue.

**What success looks like**

We'll judge this role on organic revenue and brand demand, not on how much content goes out

•        Organic channels bring in a clearly larger share of revenue.

•        Branded search is up on Google and on the marketplaces.

•        Our website ranks for the searches that matter in our categories, and that traffic converts.

•        UltraCare PRO looks and sounds like one brand wherever customers find it.

•        The team is stronger than when you joined.

**What you'll bring**

**Must have**

•        5 to 7 years in brand, content or growth marketing, working on consumer brands.

•        Hands-on experience scaling a brand. You can walk us through what you did yourself, what changed and which numbers moved.

•        Working knowledge of design, content, social media and SEO.

•        Experience leading a team, and you enjoy developing people.

•        Comfort with data. You set targets, track them in tools like GA4, Search Console and marketplace dashboards, and act on what they show.

•        Strong taste in design and writing, and the ability to explain your feedback.

•        You think about revenue as well as reach.

**Good to have**

•        D2C experience. It's a strong plus but not a requirement, so if you've scaled a brand in another setting, we'd still like to hear from you.

•        Experience in health, wellness, personal care or consumer electronics.

•        Comfort communicating health benefits responsibly, within ASCI and regulatory guidelines.

•        An understanding of how brand strength shows up in marketplace and quick commerce sales.

**Why join us**

•        
**Real ownership.**
Four teams, a clear mandate and a direct say in how the brand grows.

•        
**Demand to build on.**
Our products already sell on India's biggest marketplaces and quick commerce apps, so you're not starting from zero.

•        
**Room to lead the category.**
Many customers are still learning what these devices can do. The brand that explains best and earns the most trust can pull ahead.

•   
**Work that matters.**
Our products help people with aches and pains they deal with every day.

* Troubleshoot and debug call flow, SIP signalling, and VoIP-related customer issues.
* Monitor and ensure call quality using knowledge of VoIP protocols and network fundamentals.

**Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution**

* Diagnose and resolve VoIP call quality issues including jitter, latency, packet loss, and codec mismatches.
* Troubleshoot SIP signalling, RTP media path, and authentication failures.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on recurring VoIP incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Coordinate with carriers and third-party vendors for SIP trunk and interconnect issue resolution.

**Qualification & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or equivalent field.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of practical experience with Asterisk / FusionPBX / FreeSwitch / VICIdial or other telephony platforms.
* **Certifications (if any):**
  CCNA-Voice or CCNP-Collaboration preferred; Relevant certifications in VoIP, Asterisk, or networking are a plus.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Technical Skills:**
  Asterisk, FusionPBX, FreeSwitch, ViCIdial; Oracle SBC / Session Border Controllers; SIP, RTP, SRTP, WebRTC, TCP/IP, UDP; Linux CLI; IVR design and deployment; Hosted Contact Centre platforms.
* **Functional Skills:**
  SIP trunk configuration and management; Call flow design; Contact centre administration; VoIP troubleshooting; Integration with EPBX and CUCM.
* **Behavioral Competencies:**
  Analytical and systematic problem-solving; Ability to work independently and under pressure; Good documentation skills; Strong coordination with cross-functional and vendor teams.

title: IT Service Desk Specialist 3
description:
Make a meaningful impact on global healthcare — and grow your career while doing it. At ProductLife Group, you’ll join an innovative, forward‑thinking team operating across the world to shape the future of life sciences through expertise, collaboration, and purpose‑driven work.
  
  
‎‎
  
  
**Job Description**
The IT Service Desk Specialist is responsible for providing first-level IT support to end users, ensuring the timely and effective management and resolution of service requests and incidents.
  
  
The role involves the analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of tickets within the assigned scope, as well as the appropriate escalation of issues requiring specialized expertise. When necessary, the Service Desk Specialist collaborates with internal technical teams, subject matter experts and software vendors to investigate and resolve more complex issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and monitor incidents and service requests through the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform.
* Analyze, troubleshoot and resolve user issues within the scope of the Service Desk.
* Ensure accurate and timely ticket documentation, including troubleshooting activities, resolution and relevant communications.
* Prioritize and manage tickets according to their urgency, impact and applicable Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate internal expert teams or external software vendors.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and software vendors during the investigation and resolution of technical issues.
* Follow up on escalated tickets to ensure timely resolution and effective communication with the end user.
* Provide clear and professional communication to users throughout the incident/request lifecycle.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of knowledge articles, FAQs and troubleshooting documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and continuous improvement activities.
* Follow company IT policies, procedures and security requirements, with particular attention to the regulatory and compliance context of the Life Sciences industry.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Previous experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk or IT Support role.
* Good understanding of IT support and troubleshooting processes.
* Experience working with ticketing / ITSM tools.
* Experience with RxLogix is a plus
* Ability to analyze issues, identify possible causes and determine appropriate resolution or escalation paths.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-service orientation.
* Ability to work effectively with technical teams, subject matter experts and external software vendors.
* Ability to manage multiple tickets and priorities in a structured manner.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Experience in a regulated environment, preferably within the Life Sciences industry, is considered a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Problem-solving and analytical mindset.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Customer-oriented approach.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve processes and knowledge.

**Working Hours & Service Coverage**
The role is part of a global Service Desk operating on a 24x7 basis to ensure continuous service coverage. The successful candidate, based in India, may be required to work on a shift-based schedule, including:
  
  

* 00:00–08:00
* 08:00–17:00
* Weekend shifts, as required to ensure continuous 24x7 service coverage.

Shift assignments will be planned according to business and service requirements.
  
  
‎
  
  
Ready to take the next step? Apply today and join a global, innovative team that’s shaping the future of life sciences and empowering people to make a real impact in healthcare.

title: Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to join our centralized Patch Management team.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across Windows and Unix server environments. This role requires strong operating system administration skills, hands-on experience with vulnerability remediation, knowledge of third-party and open-source software vulnerabilities, and the ability to develop, test, and deploy automated remediation solutions.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and software vendors to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established remediation timelines while maintaining system stability, availability, and compliance with organizational security standards. Key Responsibilities
**Required Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Windows and Unix Operating System Administration
* Strong hands-on experience administering Windows Server and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Group Policy Objects (GPOs), shared file systems, user and access management, software installation, configuration, and system administration.
* Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, and patch installation issues.
* Understanding of server dependencies, system services, permissions, and configurations that may affect patch deployment and remediation.
* Experience supporting enterprise server environments and performing security updates with minimal operational disruption.
* Vulnerability Analysis and Third-Party Software Remediation
* Experience investigating vulnerabilities identified through Software Composition Analysis (SCA), software scanning, and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Ability to analyze vulnerability findings affecting operating systems, third-party applications, open-source components, and installed software.
* Knowledge of software installation paths, package dependencies, vulnerable libraries, application versions, and other factors required to determine the root cause of vulnerabilities.
* Ability to identify appropriate remediation options, including vendor patches, software upgrades, configuration changes, component replacement, or removal of vulnerable software.
* Experience coordinating with software vendors, opening support cases, reviewing release notes, validating remediation recommendations, and implementing tested solutions.
* Ability to develop remediation plans and coordinate with application and infrastructure owners to complete remediation within SLAs.
* Scripting, Automation, and BigFix
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, and other relevant automation technologies.
* Hands-on experience with BigFix or similar enterprise patch management platforms.
* Ability to develop, test, and maintain automation scripts for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, software upgrades, and compliance validation.
* Experience automating repetitive operational activities to improve remediation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Ability to troubleshoot failed deployments and automate post-remediation verification wherever feasible.
* Application Packaging and Software Deployment
* Knowledge of application packaging, software installation, configuration, and deployment processes is a plus.
* Experience preparing, testing, and deploying third-party and open-source software updates across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to analyze application installation requirements, dependencies, compatibility considerations, and potential operational impacts.
* Understanding of software versioning, package management, installation parameters, and silent installation techniques.
* Experience with BigFix or similar tools for software distribution and deployment is desirable.
* Vulnerability Remediation, Change Management, and Troubleshooting
* Experience executing security patching and vulnerability remediation activities across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to prioritize remediation based on vulnerability severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and organizational remediation timelines.
* Knowledge of change management processes, maintenance windows, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and post-deployment validation.
* Ability to investigate failed patches, installation errors, application compatibility issues, and other remediation blockers.
* Experience coordinating with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and other stakeholders to resolve remediation challenges.
* Ability to maintain accurate remediation records, provide status updates, and support security compliance and audit reporting.
* Analyze vulnerability and software scanning findings affecting Windows and Unix/Linux servers.
* Investigate reported vulnerabilities to determine the affected software, installation locations, vulnerable components, and appropriate remediation approach.
* Develop and execute remediation plans for operating system, third-party, and open-source software vulnerabilities.
* Identify applicable vendor fixes, security updates, software upgrades, and alternative treatment options.
* Coordinate with software vendors and application owners to obtain remediation guidance and resolve technical dependencies.
* Test patches and software updates in non-production environments, validate results, and coordinate production deployment through approved change management processes.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell, shell, and BigFix automation to improve patch deployment and vulnerability remediation efficiency.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, software installation issues, compatibility problems, and post-deployment incidents.
* Perform post-remediation validation to confirm that vulnerabilities have been addressed and systems remain operational.
* Track remediation progress, maintain evidence, document exceptions and blockers, and provide accurate status updates to management and security stakeholders.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams to meet remediation SLAs and maintain compliance with organizational security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve patching processes, automation, deployment reliability, and overall vulnerability remediation effectiveness.
* Relevant experience in Windows and Unix/Linux server administration, enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in a large enterprise IT environment with established change management and security compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical teams and application stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple remediation activities and meet defined deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Hands-on experience with BigFix for patch management, software deployment, and automation.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools such as Qualys or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of security advisories, CVEs, vulnerable software components, and vendor remediation guidance.
* Experience with application packaging and third-party software lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with enterprise vulnerability management processes, remediation SLAs, and security compliance requirements.

**Skills**
UNIX / Windows, Patch Management, Vulnerability Management

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

This is an exciting opportunity for you to be a part of this journey!!

Microsoft Dynamics AX,Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management,Dynamics AX Technical Development,D365 Technical Development,X++,Object-Oriented Programming,Dynamics AX/D365 Coding Standards,ERP Technical Consulting,Enterprise ERP,Forms

title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

title: Network Engineering - Architecture Focus
description:
**Job Description**
Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: [Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end-to-end across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture & Strategy
  
  

* Own the end-to-end target-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security & Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro-segmentation, and identity-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI & Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site-to-site, and remote-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end-to-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud & Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch & Site Modernization
* Architect branch network modernization for our global manufacturing and distribution footprint, including SD-WAN and Zero Trust Branch patterns.
* Improve user experience, application access, and operational simplicity at sites by reducing dependence on centralized backhaul.
* Define site reference designs that scale across geographies and plant types. Leadership & Influence
* Mentor staff and senior engineers; raise the technical bar across the networking discipline.
* Partner with vendors and strategic technology partners on evaluations, proofs of concept, and roadmap alignment.
* Translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, business-relevant recommendations for senior leadership.
* Maintain authoritative network documentation — reference designs, topology diagrams, and standards — that the broader engineering organization can rely on. What you’ll need to be successful Must-haves
* 10+ years of network engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in an architecture role at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining enterprise reference architectures and standards adopted across a multi-site organization.
* Deep expertise across enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF), segmentation, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless.
* Strong network security architecture experience with platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass.
* Strong Azure networking experience, including VNet design, peering, private connectivity, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Experience with DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), IP schema design, and core service resiliency.
* Proven experience architecting Zero Trust Branch, micro-segmentation, or identity aware network access.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to work across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments in a global, distributed enterprise.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues clearly for both engineering and non-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement capabilities at the Director and VP level. Nice-to-haves
* Experience in manufacturing, CPG, or other industrial environments with significant OT/IT convergence considerations.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCDE, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or TOGAF.
* Experience leading vendor evaluations and architecture proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with network automation, infrastructure as code, and enterprise observability platforms. Our Total Rewards philosophy Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future — we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. title: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, in the office · Monday to Saturday, Australian hours · ₹15 LPA plus bonus**

Applications close Sunday 1 November 2026.

**FROM PRIYANK, THE FOUNDER**

Before I became a broker, I worked for the lenders: Lending Manager at Bank of Melbourne and Commercial Credit Analyst at La Trobe Financial. I started Prevail Finance in 2017. Today I meet our clients and structure their loans. I need one person I can hand every deal to: someone who knows Australian credit inside out, still works files themselves, and wants to build the team that gets every loan to settlement without me chasing it.

**HOW A DEAL MOVES HERE**

1. I meet the client, set the strategy and structure, and hand the deal to you with my notes.
2. You assess it: documents, income, serviceability and lender policy. You write the credit proposal, with lender options and risks, and we workshop it together.
3. I confirm the recommendation with the client. All credit advice stays with me as the licence holder.
4. You and your team package the file, lodge it through ApplyOnline, and take it through valuation, conditions, approval and loan documents to settlement.
5. Your team keeps the client updated at every step.

**WHAT YOU’RE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

Above all, one result: every loan we write settles on time, with no errors. You will:

* assess and write up the complex files yourself: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, business and commercial loans
* check your team’s work before anything reaches a lender: documents, servicing inputs, and the identity, anti-money-laundering and responsible lending checks
* keep SalesTrekker current, so every file has an owner, a next step and a date
* work with lenders and their BDMs on policy, pricing, conditions and valuations
* train and lead the loans team, and help choose its next hire

You report to me, and to a General Manager once we appoint one.

**A DAY IN THE ROLE**

You start early, on Australian hours. First the pipeline: which files need you, which settlements are close, what’s at risk. Then your own files: a new deal from me to assess, a credit proposal to finish, a condition to clear. Through the day you review your team’s files before lodgement, call BDMs, and unblock whatever is stuck. Each week you run the pipeline review. You finish in the afternoon IST, with every client updated and tomorrow’s priorities set.

**WHY THE RIGHT PERSON WILL WANT THIS**

* Real deals, not volume: business owners buying premises, commercial property, construction and business purchases, from $400k to $10M+.
* You learn from me. I’ve assessed these loans at a bank and at a non-bank lender, and I still develop property myself.
* You’re our first credit leader. You set the standards everyone after you works to.
* Premium pay, published: ₹15 LPA plus bonus.
* Your authority is in writing from day one. By day 90 you run the pipeline and I’ve stopped chasing files.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 5+ years assessing or processing Australian loans for brokers or lenders, onshore or offshore, from application to settlement
* Experience with self-employed borrowers trading through companies and trusts: financials, tax returns, add-backs
* Current hands-on work: you still work files yourself, not only supervise
* Experience leading, training or checking other people’s work
* A degree in commerce, accounting, finance or banking
* Clear spoken and written English: you’ll talk to Australian lenders every day

Even better: commercial, business, construction or development loans. Mercury, Infynity, BrokerEngine or SalesTrekker.

Not for you if: you’ve only worked on US or UK mortgages, or you’ve moved into management and no longer work files yourself.

**WHERE AND WHEN**

Our Gandhinagar office. You live within about 30 km, or relocate before you start. Monday to Saturday, on Australian hours: an early start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email priyank@prevailfinance.com.au with your CV, current location and notice period, and a link to one video of up to five minutes answering:

1. An Australian loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, which you personally turned around: the lender, what was wrong, what you did, and what happened.
2. A time you held a colleague to a standard they weren’t meeting: what you said, and what happened next.
3. One thing in this ad you’d do differently, and why.

Record it on your phone, without a script. Send it as a Google Drive, unlisted YouTube or Loom link that anyone can open.

Subject line: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – your name

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Every applicant gets a reply. Shortlisted applicants have a 60-minute interview with me, then a working session on a real past file with every client detail removed. On appointment: a written role agreement, a police check, and a three-month window to show the role works, for both sides. Every application is assessed on the same standard, and nothing without a bearing on the work counts.

Do you approach new challenges with passion and take responsibility for your actions? Be the change you want to see and start shaping industry from the inside.
  
  
**Who are we?**
Trelleborg Industrial Solutions (TIS) is a global leader in innovative polymer-based solutions for key industries and critical infrastructure. We are one of three Business Areas within the Trelleborg Group, with a total of about 6 200 employees around the world.
  
  
**About The Job**
Oversee day-to-day operations of the Finance Shared Services centre across Order to Cash (O2C), Procure to Pay (P2P) and Record to Report (R2R) processes. Ensure SLA delivery, statutory compliance, internal controls and a strong customer service culture, while building team capability and driving operational excellence in line with Trelleborg standards and jurisdictional regulatory requirements.
  
  

* Operations Management
* Oversee day-to-day delivery of O2C, P2P and R2R processes through the respective Team Leads, ensuring SLAs, KPIs and the month-end close calendar are consistently met.
* Creating Standardized Processes based on existing ones and feedback from TLs for improvement
* Prepare consolidated FSS performance dashboards (DSO, DPO, close timeliness, error rates, query ageing) and drive corrective actions for underperforming areas.
* Act as the escalation point for cross-functional issues spanning O2C, P2P and R2R (e.g., intercompany mismatches, cash application affecting payables, GL postings affecting reconciliations).
* Coordinate resourcing, workload balancing and contingency planning across teams, especially during peak periods (month-end/year-end close, audit cycles).
* Represent FSS Operations in governance meetings with business unit Controllers, Group Finance and Product Area stakeholders.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the FSS Head

'B. Statutory Compliance & Audit Oversight
  
  

* Ensure consistent compliance across O2C, P2P and R2R with GST/VAT, TDS/WHT, Income Tax, Companies Act and Cost Audit (CRA Rules) requirements relevant to operations.
* Act as a key point of contact for Statutory, Internal and Cost Auditors, ensuring audit requests across all three processes are addressed within statutory deadlines.
* Review significant statutory filings, reconciliations and disclosures prepared by the Team Leads prior to submission.

'C. Controls, Risk & Governance
  
  

* Own the overall SOX / Trelleborg ICS control environment across O2C, P2P and R2R; ensure controls are designed, tested and operating effectively.
* Review and approve remediation plans for control gaps or audit findings identified within FSS Operations
* Ensure segregation of duties, access controls and approval workflows are appropriately maintained across ERP and supporting systems.
* Conduct periodic process risk reviews and ensure adequate documentation (SOPs, process maps, RCMs) is current.
* People Leadership
* Lead, coach and develop the three Team Leads and, indirectly, their teams; build a strong succession pipeline within FSS Operations.
* Drive performance management, goal setting and talent reviews across O2C, P2P and R2R teams.
* Foster a culture of customer service, accountability and continuous improvement within the FSS centre.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and training programs for team members.

**About The Ideal Candidate**
'
  
  

* CA / CMA or equivalent professional qualification
* 10 years of progressive experience in finance operations / shared services, including at least 3–5 years in a people-management role overseeing multiple finance processes.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP systems (D365 / SAP), BPC/consolidation tools and reporting/dashboarding tools.
* Strong knowledge of Indian statutory framework: Companies Act 2013, GST, Income Tax Act, TDS, Cost Audit Rules (CRA), Customs and Labour Codes.
* Demonstrated experience managing audits (statutory, internal, cost) and remediation of control findings.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and presentation skills; fluent written and oral English.

'
  
  

* Cross-functional finance operations leadership (O2C, P2P, R2R)
* SLA / KPI management and operational governance
* Indian statutory compliance across direct and indirect tax, Companies Act and Cost Audit
* Internal controls (SOX / ICS) ownership and risk management
* People leadership, coaching and talent development
* Stakeholder management with senior business and Group Finance leadership
* ERP and reporting tool proficiency (D365 / SAP, BPC)

title: Deployment Textile Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Textile Engineer to support the deployment and operation of our OneWeave™ 3D weaving technology at our manufacturing partner in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, near Naroda Road.
  
  
You’ll be the first line of textile technical support onsite, working alongside factory operators, a project manager, field service technician, and unspun’s remote textile and mechanical engineering teams. You’ll investigate what’s happening in production, run tests, analyze results, solve textile and process problems, and turn what we learn on the factory floor into continuous improvement.
  
  
You’ll also represent unspun at our partner facility, building trusted relationships and helping teams across both organizations work effectively together.
  
  
When applying, use the word shark in your cover letter.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
OneWeave™ combines textiles, robotics, sensors, software, and industrial automation to create garments and textile products directly from yarn.
  
  
As we deploy and ramp this technology in production, we need textile engineering expertise directly on the factory floor. When something involving weaving, yarn, materials, fabric quality, or process performance isn’t behaving as expected, you’ll help determine what’s happening, why it’s happening, and what we should do next.
  
  
You’ll connect what’s happening onsite in Ahmedabad with the teams developing OneWeave™ in the US, helping us improve both the technology and how we operate it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Support the deployment, testing, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of OneWeave™ at our partner factory
* Serve as the first line of response for weaving, yarn, material, fabric quality, and textile process issues
* Develop and execute test plans, operate OneWeave™ equipment, and support daily textile testing and production runs
* Perform quality testing inspection, analyzing weaving inputs and outputs using quantitative and qualitative data to identify patterns, problems, and opportunities for improvement
* Investigate textile and process issues, determine likely causes, test potential solutions, and document results
* Assess and prioritize issues based on severity, production impact, available workarounds, and urgency
* Partner with factory operations and US-based textile, mechanical, and development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues
* Support yarn and material sourcing, supplier communication, testing, and validation for development and production runs
* Work with material vendors and suppliers on testing requirements, standards, and performance
* Develop and improve machine operation and testing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, training manuals, and supporting documentation
* Identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve equipment, materials, processes, documentation, and training
* Provide clear, concise updates to US-based teams on factory status, testing, project progress, risks, findings, and next steps
* Capture technical information so engineers who aren't physically onsite can understand factory issues and take action

**Who You Are**
You’re a textile engineer who likes being close to the actual work. You understand fibers, yarns, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing processes, but you’re also comfortable getting onto the factory floor, operating equipment, running tests, and figuring out why something isn’t working as expected.
  
  
You’re curious and methodical. You don't simply fix a symptom and move on. You gather information, test assumptions, analyze results, and try to understand the underlying cause.
  
  
You also know that deployment work is collaborative. You can build strong working relationships with factory operators and managers while partnering effectively with engineers and teams thousands of miles away.
  
  
When production pressure is high, you remain composed, communicate clearly, and keep moving the work toward resolution.
  
  
**What Makes You a Great Fit?**

* 5 or more years of hands-on experience with production weaving, textile manufacturing, fabric development, and textile quality systems
* Strong understanding of textile fibers, yarn properties, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing constraints
* Experience developing and executing textile or manufacturing test plans
* Ability to collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data and translate findings into practical improvements
* Experience troubleshooting textile, weaving, material, quality, or production-process issues
* Experience working directly in a factory or production environment
* Familiarity with quality systems, root-cause analysis, production metrics such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and downtime analysis, or continuous-improvement methods
* Experience working with yarn or material suppliers on sourcing, testing, validation, or quality
* Strong written and verbal communication with factory operators, engineers, suppliers, and leadership
* Ability to document technical findings clearly for teams that aren't physically onsite
* Strong ownership, judgment, reliability, and process discipline

**Education**
Degree or diploma in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Language Requirements**

* Professional working English required
* Professional working proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi required for effective factory-floor communication (proficiency in both is strongly preferred)

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience troubleshooting automated textile manufacturing equipment
* Production deployment, ramp-up, commissioning, or New Product Introduction (NPI) experience
* Experience designing practical experiments and translating results into production improvements
* Lean Manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma, structured root-cause analysis, or continuous-improvement experience
* Experience using OEE, downtime, quality, or other production data to investigate manufacturing performance
* Experience developing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, or training materials
* Experience supporting technical teams across countries and time zones

**Schedule**
This is an onsite role based at our partner factory near Naroda Road in Ahmedabad, India.
  
  
The factory operates across three shifts. You’ll primarily support the first and second shifts and participate in on-call coverage.
  
  
During onboarding, deployment, and factory ramp-up, extended onsite days may be required. Longer-term hours will vary based on operational needs.
  
  
Some work outside normal local hours will be required for urgent production support and collaboration with US-based teams.
  
  
You must live close enough to the factory to provide practical onsite support when needed.
  
  
**International Travel**
Travel may include approximately one two-week visit per quarter, including travel to unspun's headquarters and micro-factory in Emeryville, California for training, textile development, testing, and collaboration with our US teams.
  
  
**Why unspun?**
We're not just another tech company - we're a team revolutionizing a trillion-dollar industry. Here's what makes us special:
  
  

* Mission-Driven: We're united by our goal of reducing the carbon footprint of the global apparel industry through automation
* Innovation at Scale: We're backed by top climate-tech VCs and working with major brands
* Amazing Team: Work with passionate experts who care about impact

**Our Culture**
We're relentless in pursuing our mission, intentional in our decisions, and fundamentally human in how we work together. We celebrate small wins, speak up to benefit many, and aren't afraid to make mistakes along the way.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We won't roll our eyes if your socks don't match. We get it. But then, if you spend those extra few minutes in the morning matching your socks and shirt, we get that too. Our workspaces are sometimes spotless and sometimes chaotic, and we celebrate messy exploration. We work through complex problems but generate simple and elegant solutions. We strive to look at things differently, and never do anything solely because "that's the way it's always been done."
  
  
We're a team of designers and engineers, industry-veterans and serial entrepreneurs, artists and developers. We're aspiring chess masters and climbers, bakers and photographers. Originally spun out of Stanford and the University of Colorado, we now call the SF Bay Area home, with strong ties to Hong Kong. We are looking for teammates who share our desire to work on ambitious problems and leave the world better than we found it.
  
  
*unspun is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being a diverse team that reflects a broad range of background, thought, and experience. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, status as an individual with a disability, status as protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristics. Women, minorities, and people from underrepresented backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.*
The world's first 3D weaving technology for apparel and the key to fashion's waste problem.

title: Security Control Assessment Specialist
description:
**Department:**
Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad/GiftCity
  
  
**Description**
We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.

**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
Essential Skills & Experience
  
  

* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800-53.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Desirable Skills & Experience
  
  

* Experience in financial services, capital markets or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

**Benefits**
***Competitive Benefits & Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.*

* Health & Financial Security:

+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off & Flexibility:

+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work-Life Support & Resources:

+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness & Lifestyle Perks:

+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:

+ Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies.
